subject: [PATCH v6 11/12] mm: install PMD swap entries on swap-out

2026-08-18.patch_summary: This patch improves the handling of huge pages (Transparent Huge Pages, THPs) during swap-out operations by installing PMD-level swap entries instead of splitting them into individual PTEs. This reduces overhead and preserves the original mapping across the swap round-trip. The patch introduces a new counter `thp_swpout_pmd` to track the number of PMD mappings replaced by PMD-level swap entries, which can be incremented multiple times for fork-shared THPs.
